title: Deja vu? Texans' 0-3 start means they must make NFL history to reach playoffs

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Deja vu? Texans' 0-3 start means they must make NFL history to reach playoffs
sources.description: The Houston Texans lost the Indianapolis Colts, 19-17, to start the 2026 season 0-3, just like C.J. Stroud and DeMeco Ryans' team did in 2025.
